text:
Order Confirmation – Order #55812

Because the desk is [3], two people will be needed to carry it inside. If you are not home at the time of delivery, the carrier will leave a notice [4] a new appointment can be scheduled.

questions.explanation: An order is 'processed' before it is shipped.

choices: Our showroom is open from Tuesday to Sunday.
You will receive a tracking number by e-mail once the items leave our warehouse.
Oak is one of the strongest woods.
The chairs are available in black and gray.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives shipping information and precedes the delivery date.
An adjective is needed after 'is'.
'So that' introduces the purpose of the notice.

text:

questions.explanation: After 'will', the base form is used.
An adverb is needed between the subject and the verb.

choices: The pool was built twenty years ago.
Lifeguards are on duty during all opening hours.
Swimsuits are sold at the nearby store.
questions.explanation: The sentence concerns safety and leads to the rule about children.
A noun phrase ('a private event') follows, so a preposition is needed.

questions.explanation: One 'renews' a plan, meaning one keeps it for another period.

choices: The cafeteria will serve lunch until 2 p.m.

questions.explanation: The sentence tells how to enroll, before the default rule is explained.
'Which' refers to the whole previous clause (lower premiums).
The passive 'are encouraged to' is the standard expression.

text:

questions.explanation: An adjective parallel to 'creative' is needed.

choices: No previous experience is necessary, but knowledge of social media is an advantage.

questions.explanation: The sentence describes the profile sought, before the opportunity is presented.
A compound adjective is needed before 'environment'.
The unpaid internship contrasts with the allowance provided.

text:
Retailer Reports Record Holiday Sales

Greenmart, the nation's second-largest retail chain, announced on Tuesday that holiday sales rose 9 percent [1] the same period last year. Online orders, in particular, [2] sharply, accounting for nearly one-third of total revenue. [3] Chief Financial Officer Linda Moore credited the results to an improved delivery system and aggressive discounts. She cautioned, [4], that rising costs could reduce profits in the coming months.

questions.explanation: 'Compared with' introduces the term of comparison.
The simple past is needed for a finished period.

choices: The strong performance exceeded analysts' expectations.
The company opened its first store in 1972.
Wages are rising across the sector.
questions.explanation: The sentence comments on the results, which the CFO then explains.
'However' introduces a caution that contrasts with the good news.

text:

questions.explanation: One 'expresses' gratitude.

choices: The hospital's parking lot is being renovated.

questions.explanation: The sentence praises the lecture, which the next sentence illustrates.
The past participle is needed after 'had ever'.

text:
Visitor Registration Form – Instructions

questions.explanation: 'Before entering' places the form as a first step.

choices: The cafeteria is on the ground floor.

questions.explanation: The sentence follows the instructions for filling the form and precedes the ID requirement.
Staff 'verify' an ID, meaning they check that it is valid.
'Throughout your visit' means during the entire visit.
